# Dermasculpt Clinic
> Dermatology, skin, laser, hair restoration, and anti-ageing clinic in Jayanagar, Bangalore.

Dermasculpt Clinic is led by Dr. Deepak Devakar (MBBS, DVD), a dermatologist with 18+ years of clinical experience. The clinic serves Jayanagar, JP Nagar, BTM Layout, Banashankari, Koramangala, HSR Layout, and nearby Bangalore areas.

## Core Services
- [Laser Hair Reduction](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/laser-hair-removal-jayanagar.html): Advanced laser hair reduction for face, underarms, arms, legs, bikini, and full body.
- [Acne & Pimples Treatment](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/pimples-acne-treatment-jayanagar.html): Dermatologist-led acne care, pimple treatment, and medical-grade protocols.
- [Pigmentation Treatment](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/pigmentation-treatment-jayanagar.html): Melasma, dark spots, sunspots, uneven tone, laser toning, and chemical peels.
- [PRP & GFC Hair Loss](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/prp-gfc-hair-loss-jayanagar.html): PRP and Growth Factor Concentrate therapy for hair thinning and hair fall.
- [Anti-Aging & Facial Aesthetics](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/anti-aging-jayanagar.html): Wrinkle-smoothing care, facial volume care, facial rejuvenation, and Morpheus RF skin tightening.
- [Scars Treatment](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/scars-treatment-jayanagar.html): Acne scars, surgical scars, and laser scar revision.
- [Skin Lightening](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/skin-lightening-jayanagar.html): Skin brightening, tone correction, and complexion care.
- [Laser Tattoo Removal](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/laser-tattoo-removal-jayanagar.html): Q-switched laser tattoo removal.
- [Laser Mole Removal](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/laser-mole-removal-jayanagar.html): Laser mole and skin growth removal.
- [Wart Removal](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/wart-removal-jayanagar.html): Wart removal with dermatologist-led care.
- [Pricing](https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/pricing.html): Treatment pricing overview.
